title: Access control & visitor management
summary: Card, biometric and mobile access for doors and entrances, with visitor management and attendance.
intro: Control who goes where, and know who is in the building. We install card, biometric and mobile readers, door hardware and turnstiles, set up access levels for every team, and connect visitor management and attendance so reception and HR work from the same system.

points.title: The right access for every team
points.text: Access levels by person, team and time, changed centrally when people join, move or leave.

points.title: Secure entrances
points.text: Readers, electromagnetic locks, exit buttons, and turnstiles or flap barriers where footfall is high.

points.title: Visitors welcomed and recorded
points.text: Visitor registration, badges and host alerts at reception.

points.title: Safe in an emergency
points.text: Doors release automatically when the fire alarm sounds.

includes: Biometric readers: fingerprint and face recognition
Door controllers, electromagnetic locks and exit buttons
Attendance integration for HR and payroll
Fire alarm release and CCTV integration

faqs.question: Can access control link to our attendance or HR system?
faqs.answer: Yes. Attendance data from the readers can be exported to, or integrated with, your HR and payroll system.

metaDescription: Access control and visitor management for offices in Mumbai: card, biometric and mobile readers, turnstiles, door hardware and attendance integration.
